author: Times Convert

title: Invaluable tool
body: Been using this for over a year and just can’t live without it
author: Kirsty Maclons

title: Best available option but has room for improvement
body: Need a way of disabling haptic feeback. Why is it on everything? I chose this over others because of its simplicity, the good Apple Watch app, nice widgets and nicely designed dark mode. I would love to see better statistics, give us more we won’t complain. I want the running average, the chart at the bottom should allow you to toggle between a percentage and absolute values. Great thing you can export the data and do further analysis yourself though. Add more flexibility when creating custom habit?
author: mjarus

title: Terrible app
body: Fails to update tasks. Lists completed tasks as incomplete
author: Mak263

title: Great App but…
body: The app is wonderful to use and has me meeting my goals but if I go to the analytics all my tasks seem to be incomplete even though I have completed them.
author: nonku15

title: Great interface!
body: Occasionally it seems to lose my progress in time-based goals if I pause and leave the app without completing the full amount. Also wish the step counter in the widget would update more frequently. Otherwise great! I love the subtle encouragement throughout the day.
author: Pavel P. T.

title: Disruptive and annoying
body: This app does not adhere to the Apple do not disturb settings. Other than that very helpful.

title: It works!
body: Best app ever, get it now. Never fails to remind me of what is important.
